(A) Push(item)
(B) Pop()
(C) Peek() / Top()
(D) IsEmpty()

List II:
(I) Inserts a new element at the top of the stack
(II) Removes and returns the topmost element from the stack
(III) Returns the topmost element without removing it from the stack
(IV) Evaluates whether the stack currently contains zero elements

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Push adds to top; Pop removes and returns top; Peek inspects top without removal; IsEmpty checks for zero elements.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
